src/services/assistant/vector_store.py.chromadb: Local PersistentClient only, explicit embedding_function=None and anonymized_telemetry=False; all embeddings use the gateway.

src/services/jd_store.py.chromadb.config: Local Chroma settings disable telemetry; no implicit embeddings are permitted.
src/services/jd_store.py.langchain_chroma: Local persistence/search adapter; its explicitly supplied embedding function is gateway-owned.

src/services/privacy/ner.py.transformers: Local CPU privacy NER only; both model/tokenizer require local_files_only=True. Document data never leaves the process.
src/services/privacy/ner.py.torch: Local CPU privacy NER inference only.
src/services/privacy/ner.py.spacy: Local privacy NER model loaded from disk; no hosted inference.
src/services/privacy/ner.py.underthesea: Packaged local CRF privacy NER; no hosted inference.

scripts/submit_log.py.urllib.request: Protected development-log uploader, unrelated to model/business traffic; AGENTS.md prohibits changing its logging infrastructure.
